text:
kevin: Heads up — deploybot flagged a staging E2E failure this morning for the hotfix candidate. Patch is small (auth cache invalidation). Requesting expedited prod deploy during the 1h change window starting 09:30 UTC. Need SRE + oncall approvals.
deploybot: deploybot: Incident: e2e-staging failed 2026-03-23 09:12 UTC. Candidate: gcr.redwood/llm-runtime:2026.03.23-hotfix-auth-cache. Suggested action: /deploy prep --artifact=gcr.redwood/llm-runtime:2026.03.23-hotfix-auth-cache
Samantha: What is the rollback plan if it starts flapping? we should pin traffic and canary 5% for 10m, then ramp.
Alex: +1. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. If error_rate > 1% at any gate, rollback. Who can sign off expedited?
Maria: I can approve from SRE side. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: I'm oncall and ok with expedited provided smoke passes. Need release notes link and a quick smoke run before canary.
kevin: Release notes: https://redwood-inference.s3/releases/2026-03-23-hotfix-auth-cache.md — short summary: fix cache invalidation in dedicated pool causing 503s on long-lived streams and kv cache bloat.
releasebot: releasebot: Deploy request received. To approve, react with :white_check_mark: or reply 'approve'. Change window: 09:30-10:30 UTC. Rollout policy: canary 5% (10m) -> 25% (15m) -> 100% (monitor). Metric gates enabled.
Alex: approve
Maria: :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: approve. running smoke now.
deploybot: deploybot: Smoke results: health checks pass. p50=12ms p95=48ms. No 5xx. Starting canary rollout at 09:36 UTC (5% traffic, monitor 10m).
kevin: Note: we also pinned model variant to quantized-v3 for the hotfix path per perf validation. Release tag: v2.1.9-hotfix
Samantha: Also add a temporary billing alert — batch size change risk; set alert at +30% spend for the hotfix window.
deploybot: deploybot: Canary monitoring: error_rate=0.12% (<1% gate). Proceeding to 25%.
Alex: If error_rate trends up to 0.8% within 15m, hold and call for rollback. Otherwise continue.
ops-oncall: Observability check: traces and KV cache miss rate look stable; rolling to 25% looks good.
kevin: Thanks all — marking this hotfix as "expedited-approved" and pushing the release note update. Approvals: Maria, Alex, ops-oncall. I'll run post-deploy checklist in #eng-sre and file audit note.
